subject.title: marketplace-crons: TodoColeccion entra en rate limit en create y el circuit breaker corta el lote

question: Should the next fix focus on create-side throttling/breaker behavior here, or should maintainers first resolve the adjacent TodoColeccion price-recovery create retry in https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/7169?
rationale: The code path is clear, but choosing the right rate budget, breaker scope, and ordering depends on live provider behavior and operational tolerance for skipped create work.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded create-side fix
options.body: Treat this issue as canonical and ask for a PR that isolates create-side rate-limit handling, adds focused tests, and proves the production signature drops after deploy.

options.title: Fix recovery churn first
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/7169 if maintainers believe price-error recovery is feeding product-scope create churn.

options.title: Keep observing only
options.body: Leave code unchanged temporarily and require a fresh BigQuery sample proving the signature still appears after the June TodoColeccion mitigations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded create-side fix
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as canonical and ask for a PR that isolates create-side rate-limit handling, adds focused tests, and proves the production signature drops after deploy.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn merged the first mitigation and later marked this issue confirmed-live, so they are the best visible owner for the operational priority choice.
